## Idle Startup

## One mechanic, two distribution targets.

What the lab produced

The reusable gamekit owns the loop, versioned saves, offline progress, pause behavior, and platform adapters. The same game builds as a normal browser experience and as a submission-ready YouTube Playable. There is no promised next game; the project reopens only for a specific mechanic worth studying. Microsoft Clarity measures visits to this hub only; the game and YouTube bundle remain analytics-free.

# Idle Startup

Canonical: https://idle.aliveville.com/play/idle-startup/

Idle Startup is the retained playable result of the Web Playables research lab.

## How it works

Ship product features, hire a team, raise funding rounds, and improve a simulated startup over time. The deterministic simulation continues through offline progress and resumes from a versioned local save.

## Access and privacy

The game is publicly playable without an account or installation. Saves stay in the local gamekit persistence layer; no private player state is part of public discovery.

## Distribution proof

The same game code builds for a normal browser deployment and a submission-ready YouTube Playable package through platform adapters.

Ship features. Hire the team. Raise the round.

## New game setup

- Who's the founder?
- Pick your character. Rule #1: don't run out of money.
- Founder name
- Company name
- 🎲
- Start building 🚀
- 🎲 Show me different people
- Founder
- Company

The playable page keeps player names, company names, saves, balances, progress and generated candidates in the game. This public representation contains only the authored entry instructions.
